summary: Repaired the global meeting assignment optimiser with timezone/fold resolution, room/person conflict checks, directed consecutive-transition setup checks, dependency enforcement, objective tie-breaking, and UTC ISO output.
limitations: Search is exhaustive with value/count upper-bound pruning; adversarial inputs with many equal-valued, mutually feasible room/fold alternatives may still have exponential runtime.
Timezone resolution relies on the Node Intl timezone database and the contract's supported 2024–2026 zones with minute-aligned offsets.
